description: Open a project's homepage from its name in BB's sidebar. The homepage renders the checkout's README, links to the configured repository, and starts a new thread in that project. Reads go through BB's project APIs and the project's enrolled host, so a remote browser client sees the same README as a local window. The sidebar chevron still expands and collapses threads, and disabling the plugin restores the original sidebar. Requires BB 0.43.1 or later with Plugin SDK 0.4.87 or later.
